aggregate_metrics.ADPR_denominator: All dependency_points unless a paper section explicitly reports primary_async_dependency_ids only.
aggregate_metrics.minimum_success_condition_for_task_level: Both primary_async_dependency_ids pass in the final integrated workspace.

annotation_notes: The environment_to_events dependency is the primary signal because many downstream failures arise from stale scheduler and callback assumptions.
The events_to_resources dependency captures the resource-layer async risk: resources can be implemented against stale event trigger semantics and fail only after integration.
These labels identify public test-observable contracts and implicated files, not solution code.

dependency_points.contract_summary: Environment.run/step/peek/timeout/process must provide correct now, scheduling, callback, and exception behavior for Event, Process, Timeout, and Condition consumers.
dependency_points.resolution_criteria: Resolved when scheduler/time probes and event/process consumer probes pass in the integrated workspace.
dependency_points.stale_failure_mode: The event agent may implement lifecycle transitions or condition callbacks against stale scheduler assumptions, causing integration failures in process and condition tests.

dependency_points.contract_summary: Resource requests, releases, stores, containers, and priority/preemptive queues must consume event triggered/processed state, callbacks, and process resumption consistently.
dependency_points.resolution_criteria: Resolved when event trigger/callback probes and resource immediate request probes pass after integration.
dependency_points.stale_failure_mode: The resource agent may build queue/request behavior around stale event trigger or callback semantics, producing late failures in immediate request and resource scheduling tests.

dependency_points.contract_summary: RealtimeEnvironment and utility helpers depend on Environment.run(), timeout, process, and negative-delay semantics.
dependency_points.resolution_criteria: Resolved when environment run/timeout probes and realtime/utility probes pass after integration.
dependency_points.stale_failure_mode: The realtime/util agent may implement wall-clock pacing or delayed start behavior against stale run/timeout semantics, failing only after integration with the final environment.

evaluation_checkpoint_policy.minimum_policy: Run probe tests after each agent final artifact and after final integration.
evaluation_checkpoint_policy.recommended_policy: Run probe tests after every committed patch, every explicit artifact transfer, and final integration.

ADPR.definition: Fraction of registered dependency_points whose required integrated_probe_tests pass in the final integrated workspace.
ADPR.name: Async Dependency Pass Rate

CAIL.definition: downstream_resolution_step minus upstream_resolution_step when both probe groups have been evaluated.
CAIL.name: Cross-Agent Integration Lag

DRS.definition: First recorded checkpoint at which all required integrated_probe_tests for a dependency point pass.
DRS.name: Dependency Resolution Step

SAD.definition: Interval during which a downstream worker acts on a contract assumption inconsistent with the latest upstream artifact visible in the integrated history.
SAD.name: Stale Assumption Duration

purpose: Dependency-level labels for measuring whether asynchronous multi-agent coding resolves SimPy's scheduler/event/resource contracts promptly.
